method: Screened Poisson, validated oriented depth seed plus accurate native SfM anchors; no Gaussian extraction
anchorRule: reprojection error <=1.25 native pixels, >=3 distinct training timestamps; <=.055 distance to dense surface; five-neighbor normal agreement >.80
heldOutDefinition: Evaluation timestamps excluded from qualifying tracks and texture; SfM itself was solved using all images
worldFrame: +Y up, original normalized units; no new transform
status: local pilot, requires visibility carving and visual acceptance
